verses.text: Ix sna'an winhaj David icha tik: Ol in smilnhejcham winhaj Saúl chi', yuj chi' a tikne'ik ol in b'atkan t'a schonhab' heb' filisteo yik wach' maxtzak in sayji yuj winh t'a yol ko makb'en tik. Icha chi' ol aj in kolchajel t'a yol sk'ab' winh, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh yet' wake' ciento heb' winh winak ajun yet'ok, yik b'at yak'och sb'a heb' winh schekab'ok winhaj Aquis sreyal Gat yuninal winhaj Maoc.

Ix kajnaj heb' winh yet' winhaj Aquis t'a Gat chi', junjun heb' winh yet' yetb'eyum yet' pax yuninal. Ha winhaj David chi', ix yik'b'at heb' ix yetb'eyum winh schawanhil, haton ix Ahinoam aj Jezreel yet' ix Abigail ix yetb'eyumkan winh xilb'a Nabal, aj Carmel.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl to toxo ix b'atkan winhaj David chi' elelal t'a Gat, ix yaktan winh sayanek' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj David chi' t'a winhaj Aquis chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, tzin tewi t'ayach komonok tz'el t'a a k'o'ol, tzak' jab'ok b'aj tzonh aj t'a junok yune' chonhab' t'a yol a makb'en tik. Manh smojok tzin aj het'ok t'a jun a chonhab' b'aj ayach tik, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yak' chonhab' Siclag winhaj Aquis chi' t'a winh. Yuj chi' a chonhab' Siclag chi' ix kannhej t'a yol yik heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Jun ab'il yet' chanhe' ujal ix ek' winhaj David chi' t'a yol smakb'en heb' filisteo chi'.

Ha heb' aj Gesur, heb' aj Gezer yet' heb' amalecita, niwanxo tiempo sk'och kajan heb' t'a jun lum lum t'a skal Shur yet' Egipto. Ha winhaj David chi' yet' heb' ajun yet'ok kotak skal ix b'at heb' yak' owal t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

Smilcham heb' anima heb' ta', manhxo junok winak ma ix skani. Syik'anpaxkot nok' wakax heb', nok' kalnel, nok' b'uru, nok' camello yet' pax pichul. Slajwi chi' smeltzajxikot heb' b'aj ayek' winhaj Aquis.

Sk'anb'an winhaj Aquis chi' t'a winh: --¿B'ajtil ach xit'ek' ak' owal chi' tikne'ik? xchi winh. Syalan winhaj David chi': Haton t'a sur yik Judá yet' t'a sur yik Jerameel, mato t'a sur yol smakb'en heb' ceneo, xchi winh.

Manhxa heb' winh winak, ma heb' ix ix pitzanto skan yuj winhaj David chi', yuj chi' junelnhej manhxa mach b'at halan t'a Gat tas sk'ulej winh chi'. Ha jantak tiempo'al ix ek' kajan winh t'a smakb'en heb' filisteo chi', ichanhej chi' ix sk'ulej winh.

Ha winhaj Aquis chi', ix yak'och winhaj David chi' winh yipok sk'o'ol, ix sna'an winh: Ha heb' yetisraelal winhaj David tik wan smeltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'a winh, yuj chi' ol kanxonhej winh in yak' serwil, xchi winh.
